actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

device.name: Unitree Go2 in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (rough terrain)

facts.text: The repository provides a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot simulation on Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab with a ROS 2 interface
Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.1.0 and ROS 2 Humble must be installed before the simulation runs
The ROS 2 interface subscribes to /unitree_go2/cmd_vel and publishes front-camera, LIDAR, odometry and pose topics
The Go2 is an Isaac Lab articulation spawned at {ENV_REGEX_NS}/Go2
The height scanner is a grid at 0.1 resolution over a size of 1.6 x 1.0 attached to the Go2 base
The Go2RSLEnvCfg default scene uses 2 environments with an env_spacing of 2.0
The action term is a JointPositionActionCfg over all joints matched by the regular expression .*

The observation group contains base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, the base velocity command, joint positions, joint velocities, the last action and a height scan clipped to -1..1
The velocity command ranges are all zero: lin_vel_x, lin_vel_y, ang_vel_z and heading
The environment config sets decimation to 8, sim.dt to 0.005 s and the render interval to the decimation
The episode length is 20.0 s and the finite-horizon flag is False, so the environment does not truncate on time
Joint position actions are scaled by 0.25
The height scanner update period is decimation * sim.dt
The environment is created with gym.make('Isaac-Velocity-Rough-Unitree-Go2-v0', cfg=cfg) and wrapped in RslRlVecEnvWrapper
The command input is a float32 tensor of shape (num_envs, 3)
The ROS 2 cmd_vel callback writes Twist.linear.x, linear.y and angular.z into the three command columns
The launcher overrides decimation with ceil(1/sim.dt/cfg.freq)
The sim.yaml default is 1 environment and a control frequency of 40

determinism.notes: the fake draws its initial joint offsets from Python's random.Random(seed) and its step is analytic, so one seed and action sequence repeat; the upstream environment would draw from Isaac Lab's generators, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: the fake is an analytic stand-in, not the Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab environment: it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor or noise dynamics, and the base never moves

one step is one environment transition of 40 ms (decimation 8 x sim.dt 0.005 s, go2/go2_env.py:161,164); the launcher recomputes decimation from cfg.freq (isaac_go2_ros2.py:41) and a changed frequency is not modelled here

the fake observation uses placeholder dimensions: 3 values for the base terms, 12 for the joint terms and 8 for the height scan; the upstream joint dimension comes from UNITREE_GO2_CFG outside the clone and the upstream height scan is the grid configured at go2/go2_env.py:52-58 (0.1 resolution over a 1.6 x 1.0 size), so the fake arrays are smaller stand-ins
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only

the fake was not compared with the upstream environment; Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.1.0, ROS 2 Humble and the RSL-RL checkpoint (README.md:26-30, go2/go2_ctrl.py:80-91) are absent where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone

the ROS 2 topics of the upstream bridge (/unitree_go2/cmd_vel, camera, LIDAR, odometry, pose) are not exposed by this Gymnasium contract; it serves cap.world.step, cap.world.reset and cap.world.seed only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the deployed environment exposes no get_state/set_state to the bridge

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulated world stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last state stays readable
